metadata.description: Marketplace of llm-wiki-family plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: wiki-agent-msg
plugins.description: Cross-harness live messaging: list and message Claude Code and Codex sessions on the same machine.

plugins.name: wiki-kg
plugins.description: Build and query a typed-edge knowledge graph from an llm-wiki (rdflib + pyshacl, in-process; no server).

plugins.name: wiki-graph-viz
plugins.description: Render a wiki knowledge graph as a self-contained interactive HTML map for navigation (click a page to open its GitHub wiki page).
